_comment: The garage's marks for the car scripts (see docs/modding.md, scripts). A mark is a point [x, z] on the floor, in
metres from the middle of the garage, or one measured from where the car stands: { "behind": 7 }, with ahead,
left and right. door: where a car taken out of the lot comes in from (scripts/scripts.json, garage.arrive).
paths: named lists of points, for a mod's scripts to drive along.
